title: Pre-Hardmode Melee
summary: High defense, close-range damage. Beat Skeletron and the Wall of Flesh with heavy hitters and strong armor.

weapons.label: Copper/Tin Shortsword → Muramasa or a Broadsword (world drop) early on
Fiery Greatsword (Underworld crate/drop) or Light's Bane / Blood Butcherer (crimson sword)
Bee Keeper (Queen Bee) or Terra Blade fragments not yet available here
Night's Edge (combine Muramasa, Fiery Greatsword, Blood Butcherer/Light's Bane, Blade of Grass at a Demon/Crimson Altar)
Flying weapon: Enchanted Sword / Starfury (Sky Crate, great AoE ranged-melee hybrid)
Boss finisher: Fiery Greatsword or Night's Edge into Wall of Flesh

armor.label: Shadow Armor (Corruption) or Crimson Armor (Crimson) - melee set bonus, huge early spike
Necro-adjacent alt: Molten Armor (Hellstone + Obsidian, crafted at Hellforge) - best pre-hardmode melee armor, +damage and crit

accessories.label: Any 2 of: Cloud in a Bottle / Shiny Red Balloon, Hermes Boots (or upgrades), Band of Regeneration
Obsidian Shield (no knockback + fire immunity, essential vs Wall of Flesh)
Feral Claws or Titan Glove (melee speed/knockback) if farmed early
Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths for potion cooldown

notes: Molten Armor + Obsidian Shield + Fiery Greatsword or Night's Edge is the standard pre-hardmode melee power spike. Farm Hellstone with obsidian skull/potion + lava charm before engaging the Wall of Flesh. Use Obsidian Skin or Fireproof potions for lava safety.

title: Pre-Hardmode Ranged
summary: Strong single-target and crowd control from range; ammo economy matters early.

weapons.label: Wooden Bow → Shark Tooth Necklace + Minishark for early clear speed
Star Cannon (Sky Crate) or Minishark/Undertaker for boss fights
The Bee's Knees (Queen Bee drop) as a strong bow option
Harpoon (fishing) for a spear-like ranged option

armor.label: Ranger-focused: Necro Armor (Skeletron drops helmet/parts + Tabi/Ninja Gear pieces) for the classic ranged crit/damage set
Jungle/Meteor armor as filler if Necro isn't up yet

accessories.label: Cloud in a Bottle, Hermes Boots, Band of Regeneration
Obsidian Shield for Wall of Flesh

notes: Necro Armor requires killing Skeletron (Headgear from Skeletron drop, other pieces from Shadow Orbs/Crimson Hearts). Stock Musket Balls or Meteor Shots and keep distance during boss fights.

title: Pre-Hardmode Mage
summary: Highest burst potential pre-hardmode but mana-hungry; strongest against Wall of Flesh with Water Bolt/Space Gun spam.

weapons.label: Water Bolt (Book, found underground) - cheap mana, strong dps
Space Gun (crafted or found) - infinite ammo, no mana cost
Demon Scythe (Corruption) or Vilethorn (Crimson) as an early magic weapon
Flamelash (Underworld) for strong hallway damage vs Wall of Flesh

armor.label: Jungle Armor (Jungle biome drops) for early mana/damage
Meteor Armor (Meteorite, post-meteor-crash) - iconic pre-hardmode mage set with Space Gun synergy

accessories.label: Mana Flower (combine Mana regen band + Magic quiver-like items later)
Band of Regeneration, Celestial Magnet-line accessories once available
Obsidian Shield for Wall of Flesh

notes: Meteor Armor set bonus reduces Space Gun mana cost to 0, making it essentially free infinite damage - extremely strong vs Wall of Flesh with mana potions in reserve.

title: Pre-Hardmode Summoner
summary: Weakest pre-hardmode class but still viable with careful positioning; hybridize with another weapon type.

weapons.label: Slime Staff (Slime drop) - reliable early summon
Flinx Staff (Snow biome) as an early alternative
Optic Staff (Queen Bee drop) - strong pre-hardmode summon upgrade

armor.label: Bee Armor (Queen Bee drops/Honey biome) - summon damage focused set

accessories.label: Hermes Boots, Cloud in a Bottle, Band of Regeneration
Obsidian Shield for Wall of Flesh

notes: Summoner is thin on pre-hardmode content - use a ranged or melee weapon as your main damage source and let the summon supplement. Keep moving during the Wall of Flesh fight; summons don't need direct line of sight.

title: Early Hardmode Melee
summary: Transition through ore tiers up to a Mechanical Boss kill.

weapons.label: Cobalt/Palladium Sword/Broadsword, then Mythril/Orichalcum tier
Adamantite/Titanium tier: Excalibur (Pumpkin Moon-adjacent / Hallowed Bar) or a Drax/Pickaxe-Axe for mobility+damage
Cobalt/Mythril/Adamantite Repeaters as hybrid options

accessories.label: Ankh Shield, Frostspark Boots (once Ice Feather/Frostburn arrow farmed), Warrior/Berserker Emblem

notes: Priority order: pick one metal per tier consistently (don't mix, some set bonuses require full sets). Aim to fight a Mechanical Boss (Twins/Destroyer/Skeletron Prime) as early as possible to unlock Hallowed gear.

title: Early Hardmode Ranged
summary: Repeaters and early Hardmode guns carry you through the mechanical bosses.

weapons.label: Cobalt/Palladium/Mythril/Adamantite Repeaters
Shotgun (Golden Lock Box or found) once available
Venus Magnum / Uzi upgrades from ore tiers

accessories.label: Ankh Shield, Magic Quiver, Ranger Emblem

notes: Ranged scales very well through Hardmode ore tiers - keep upgrading repeaters and pick up any craftable guns you can afford.

title: Early Hardmode Mage
summary: Meteor/Jungle into ore-tier magic sets; Water Bolt/Golden Shower carry until Mechanical Bosses drop better tools.

weapons.label: Golden Shower (Crimson, post-Hardmode) - strong DoT weapon
Crystal Storm / Cobalt-tier magic weapons
Rainbow Rod / Bat Scepter (Corruption/Crimson) once accessible

accessories.label: Ankh Shield, Mana Flower, Sorcerer Emblem

notes: Golden Shower is a standout early Hardmode weapon - its defense-reduction debuff makes mechanical boss fights much easier for your whole team.

title: Early Hardmode Summoner
summary: Summoner comes online hard in Hardmode - Spider armor and Pygmy/Sanguine staffs are a huge spike.

weapons.label: Spider Staff (Spider biome, Corruption/Crimson underground) - massive pre-Plantera summon upgrade
Optic Staff carries until Spider Staff is farmed

armor.label: Spider Armor (Black Fairy/Spider biome) - best pre-Plantera summoner set

accessories.label: Ankh Shield, Necromantic Scroll, Summoner Emblem

notes: Spider Armor + Spider Staff is considered one of the strongest single power spikes in the whole game for summoners - prioritize farming the Spider biome as soon as Hardmode starts.

title: Post-Mechanical Bosses → Plantera Melee
summary: Hallowed gear and yoyos/flails carry into Plantera.

weapons.label: Hallowed/Chlorophyte-tier swords, Yoyos (Amarok, Yoyo Bag)
True Excalibur / True Night's Edge
Flairon (post-Plantera, farmed from Dungeon/Plantera loop) as a goal weapon

armor.label: Hallowed Armor (Mechanical Boss bars) for the melee set
Turtle Armor (post-Plantera, Chlorophyte + Turtle shells) as the follow-up

accessories.label: Ankh Shield, Fire Gauntlet, Warrior Emblem, Yoyo Bag

notes: Fight Plantera in the Jungle for Chlorophyte access first, then farm Turtle armor from the Jungle's Turtles once Chlorophyte ore is available.
